title: 第11章 打算离开第12章 打劫
slug: 为了长生不死我带着全宗修仙
content_zh:
;;
两枚“废丹”卖了十四颗中品灵石，十颗正常回春丹卖了十颗上品灵石。
除了炼丹炉是买来的，其他药材都是在外面采的，成本也就几个中品灵石而已。
炼丹这一行，简直是暴利啊！
“掌柜的，麻烦按照这个单子抓一些药材。”寂月从袖中拿出一张单子，上面都是她需要的药材。
一些普通的药材在外面倒是可以采到，但是一些珍贵的药材则是在秘境中才有，或者是一些比较艰险的地方。
再者，她的时间不多，没那么多的时间去找药材，现成的药材铺就在眼前，她犯不着费那么大的劲。
掌柜的接过单子，乐呵呵地说了句稍等。
出门的时候看了一眼单子，药材五花八门的都有，看不出具体是要炼什么丹。
不过药材算不上多珍贵，用灵石能买到。
前后也不过一刻钟的时间，药材就已经抓好了。
“客官，你要的药材。”
“多谢。”
寂月接过东西付了钱，转身就走。
这次只是来试试水，看一看市场，也是为了挣点钱，下次的话她就不亲自出场了吧，有点掉逼格。
掌柜的有心结交，但是看她一副疏离的样子，想了想还是放弃了。
炼丹师的性格本就不一样，万一对方就喜欢安安静静的交易，他这一折腾不就直接把人给吓跑了？
回到客栈后，寂月发现那俩丫头就没出过房间，一直都在修炼。
她们不像她，即便没有主动修炼，那些灵气也会主动往她身体里钻。要想有自保的能力，就得花费足够的时间，她们还是有这点自觉的。
寂月无奈地摇了摇头，说实在的，到现在她当这个师父都有点虚。

系统要是提前给了她一百年的修炼时间，不说元婴，就是金丹，她都有当师父的底气。
但是她现在只是练气八层啊！
别人要是知道她们有个练气八层的师父，怕是得被笑话死吧。
寂月吐出一口浊气后，进入房间，又开始研究炼丹的事情。
市面上买的炼丹炉品质其实不太好，炼过几次之后已经开始出现裂痕了，再炼两次估计得炸炉。
若说剑是剑修的对象，那炼丹炉就是炼丹师的对象。
找对象肯定是得找一个合心意的，以后也要时时刻刻地呵护“它”。
现在嘛，就只能凑合着。
希望以后的对象不要觉得膈应。
乱七八糟想了这么一通后，寂月开始炼丹。
这次要炼的是聚灵丹，听名字就通俗易懂，它能帮助修士修炼，加快修炼速度，将周围的灵气聚集起来。
算是个小作弊神器吧。
有了之前炼丹的经验后，寂月在处理药材上倒是有点顺手起来，也因为她谨慎的性子，所以炸炉的次数几乎没有。
炼出一炉高品质的聚灵丹，没有废丹，一炉出了十颗，各个香气十足，圆滚滚的看着很是可爱。
“好像炼丹也没有多难啊！”她忍不住感慨了一声。

Two "waste pills" were sold for fourteen middle-grade spiritual stones, and ten normal rejuvenation pills were sold for ten high-grade spiritual stones.
Except for the alchemy furnace, which was purchased, other medicinal materials were collected outside, and the cost was only a few medium-grade spiritual stones.
The alchemy business is a huge profit!
"Shopkeeper, please grab some medicinal materials according to this list." Jiyue took out a list from her sleeve, which contained the medicinal materials she needed.
Some common medicinal materials can be collected outside, but some precious medicinal materials are only found in secret realms, or in some relatively difficult and dangerous places.
Furthermore, she didn't have much time to find medicinal materials. The ready-made medicinal materials shop was right in front of her, so she didn't have to put in so much effort.
The shopkeeper took the order and said cheerfully, "Wait a moment."
When I went out, I took a look at the list. There were all kinds of medicinal materials, but I couldn't tell what kind of elixir I wanted to make.
However, the medicinal materials are not very precious and can be purchased with spirit stones.
In only a quarter of an hour, the medicinal materials were already prepared.
"Sir, the medicinal materials you want."
"Thank you."
Jiyue took the things, paid for them, turned around and left.
This time she just came to test the waters and take a look at the market, and also to make some money. Next time she won't appear in person, which is a bit out of character.
The shopkeeper wanted to make friends, but seeing her distant look, he gave up after thinking about it.
The alchemist's personality is different. If the other party likes a quiet transaction, wouldn't he just scare the person away with this hassle?
After returning to the inn, Jiyue discovered that the two girls had never left the room and had been practicing.
Unlike her, even if they don't take the initiative to practice, the spiritual energy will actively penetrate into her body. If they want to have the ability to protect themselves, they have to spend enough time, and they still have this consciousness.
Jiyue shook her head helplessly. To be honest, she felt a little weak as a master until now.
If the system had given her a hundred years of cultivation time in advance, she would have had the confidence to become a master, not only the Nascent Soul, but also the Golden Elixir.
But she is only practicing at the eighth level now!
If others knew that they had a master who was at the eighth level of Qi training, they would probably be laughed to death.
After Jiyue exhaled a breath of turbid air, she entered the room and began to study alchemy again.
The quality of the alchemy furnaces purchased on the market is actually not very good. After refining it a few times, cracks have begun to appear, and the furnace will probably explode after refining it twice.
If the sword is the object of sword cultivation, then the alchemy furnace is the object of the alchemist.
When looking for a partner, you must find someone you like, and you must take care of "it" all the time in the future.
Now, I just have to make do.
I hope future partners won’t feel uncomfortable.
After thinking about it all, Jiyue began to refine the elixir.
What I want to practice this time is the Spirit Gathering Pill. The name is easy to understand. It can help monks practice, speed up their practice, and gather the surrounding spiritual energy.
It's a little cheating artifact.
With her previous experience in alchemy, Jiyue became a little more comfortable in handling medicinal materials, and because of her cautious temperament, she rarely blew up the furnace.
I made a furnace of high-quality spirit-gathering pills. There were no waste pills. Ten pills were produced in one furnace. Each one was full of fragrance and looked very cute.
"It seems that making alchemy is not that difficult!" She couldn't help but sigh.
